About me

I work at the intersection of academic research and industry, focusing on intelligent localization, multi-sensor fusion, and embedded AI. My research connects algorithm development with embedded system design to bring positioning and sensing capabilities to wearable and IoT platforms.

My broader research interests span sensing and navigation for mobile and autonomous systems, with an emphasis on real-time state estimation, embedded intelligence, and hardware–software co-design.

Research interests

Intelligent localization & navigation · Multi-sensor fusion & on-device AI · Embedded systems & industrial IoT

Selected publications

All publications
2026

Location-Based Safety Management with Wearable Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Positioning

Anh-Van Vu, Seungwoo Chae, Changmin Sung, Van-Tuan Nguyen, Dongsoo Han

arXiv · Preprint

A wearable–cloud positioning architecture that combines GNSS, inertial, and barometric measurements with map-aware fusion for continuous indoor–outdoor localization. The system supports geofencing and real-time monitoring for industrial safety under device power and communication constraints.

PDFarXivDetails & citation
2025

A Black-Box Positioning Solution for Effortless Integration in Wearable Navigation

Anh-Van Vu, Changmin Sung, Dongsoo Han

IEEE SMC

Presents PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module that performs real-time sensor fusion on an embedded processor and provides position estimates through I²C, SPI, and UART. Hardware–software co-design simplifies integration into low-power wearable and IoT platforms.

ManuscriptDOIDetails & citation
2024

Real-time Pedestrian Dead Reckoning For IoT Based Platform-Independent Positioning System

Anh-Van Vu, Thanh-Minh Nguyen, Changmin Sung, Dongsoo Han

IEEE SMC

An embedded pedestrian dead reckoning algorithm with acceleration-differential step detection and dynamic gyroscope bias updates. Processing inertial measurements directly on K-Tag reduces communication with the positioning server while supporting low-latency relative localization.
